metrics.label: Open access
metrics.definition: Open access = OpenAlex oa_status is known and is not 'closed' (diamond, gold, hybrid, green or bronze). Only when oa_status is unknown for a paper does the legacy inference apply (Unpaywall/OpenAlex is_oa, an OA journal, a best-OA-location URL or an Unpaywall licence). Every OA number on the site uses this one rule, so the OA rate equals 1 - closed wherever oa_status is complete.

metrics.label: Data sharing
metrics.definition: Share with a dataset in a public repository (DataCite, Dryad, Figshare, Dataverse) or a data-repository link found in the title, abstract or metadata.

metrics.label: Code sharing
metrics.definition: Share with a GitHub repository or code-repository link.

metrics.label: Any repository / materials
metrics.definition: Share with any repository, code or data link (GitHub, Zenodo, OSF, Crossref relations, dataset repositories, LLM-extracted links).

metrics.label: Preprint version
metrics.definition: Share with a preprint version on a preprint server (OpenAlex locations), falling back to a preprint URL/identifier when metadata is missing.

metrics.label: Registration signal
metrics.definition: Share whose title or abstract cites a trial-registry ID (NCT, ISRCTN, ChiCTR, ...), PROSPERO, or preregistration wording (regex). Denominator: papers with an abstract.

metrics.label: Data-availability statement (full text)
metrics.definition: Share of audited open-access full texts (Europe PMC sample) that contain a data-availability statement. Denominator: audited papers.

metrics.label: GitHub in full text
metrics.definition: Share of audited open-access full texts that mention github.com anywhere. Denominator: audited papers; a full-text counterpart of the abstract-based code-sharing signal.

metrics.label: Trial registration in full text
metrics.definition: Share of audited open-access full texts that mention a trial-registry ID, clinicaltrials.gov or PROSPERO anywhere. Denominator: audited papers.

methods_notes: All sharing and registration signals are lower bounds: they are detected from titles, abstracts, URLs and bibliographic metadata, so practices not mentioned there are missed.

Rates are computed over journal articles and reviews only (in_article_corpus): OpenAlex type article/review in a journal source, matched by DOI. Records without a DOI or without an OpenAlex record (for example the DOI-less conference abstracts published in Stroke) are excluded, as are datasets, preprint records, errata, book chapters and repository items.

Data-availability statements (DAS) were audited only on the Europe PMC open-access full-text subset (a per-year sample), so DAS rates are optimistic relative to the whole corpus and refer to the audited papers, not to all papers.
2025, 2026 are incomplete: indexing lag and embargoes mean counts and some rates (especially green OA and preprint links) will change as records are updated.
Journals and first-author countries outside the per-discipline top lists are folded into “Other”. Journal names are normalised (case, whitespace) before ranking.

Funders are multi-valued: a paper with three funders is counted once under each. Funder counts therefore do not sum to the paper total, and a funder filter cannot be combined with journal or country filters.

OA status (diamond, gold, hybrid, green, bronze, closed) is the OpenAlex classification and the OA rate is derived from it (open = oa_status not closed), so OA rate and 1 − closed agree wherever oa_status is known; the legacy is_oa / OA-journal / OA-URL / licence inference is used only for papers whose oa_status is unknown.

high_impact.description: High-impact subset: journal IF ≥ 10 or citation count ≥ the 90th percentile of the discipline's papers, pooled across all years.

study_design.description: Trials = reports of interventional trials and their secondary analyses: PubMed indexes the paper as a trial (randomized controlled trial, clinical trial, any phase, or trial protocol), or its title and abstract describe one (randomised, trial, phase, placebo- or sham-controlled, blinded, participants randomly assigned, an analysis of a named trial). Systematic reviews, meta-analyses, OpenAlex reviews, letters and animal studies are not trials. Registry numbers are not used, so registration rates by design are not circular.

policy_events.label: ICMJE: data-sharing statement required for trials
policy_events.detail: Manuscripts submitted from 1 July 2018 reporting clinical trials must carry a data-sharing statement (ICMJE, 2017 editorial).

policy_events.label: Plan S in force
policy_events.detail: cOAlition S funders require immediate open access for grants from 1 January 2021.

policy_events.label: OSTP memo: no embargo for US-funded research
policy_events.detail: US Office of Science and Technology Policy memorandum of 25 August 2022; agencies to implement by end of 2025.

policy_events.label: NIH Data Management and Sharing Policy
policy_events.detail: In force for NIH applications from 25 January 2023; an approved plan is a term of award.
